title: files.new
label: 新建工程
description: new({context}); complete current context; dirty replacement is always rejected by page API. Default name: 新建工程YYYYMMDD-NNN using the current local date and a daily browser-persisted sequence (minimum three digits); no explicit name argument.
inputContract: new({context}); complete current context; dirty replacement is always rejected by page API. Default name: 新建工程YYYYMMDD-NNN using the current local date and a daily browser-persisted sequence (minimum three digits); no explicit name argument.
outputContract: New document identity and instance on commit; getState().summary.name reads the generated name. Existing opened projects and user renames retain their names.
errorModel: Direct files calls throw or reject with error.code. invoke({method:"files.new",args}) catches failures into a structured failed result. Underlying document/kernel and browser I/O errors can propagate; inspect error.code and message.

selectionGuide.chooseWhen: 新建空工程并替换当前设计；不默默丢弃未保存更改。

alternatives.chooseWhen: 读文件格式、大小与宿主写入能力，不证明某文件已读到。
登记获授权原始字节，返回资源 ID；尚未打开/导入。
替换整个当前设计，原工程文件可带历史；不是合并插入。
把已登记模型插入当前工程，原对象保留；交换文件不恢复源 CAD 特征树。
旧文件选择兼容操作；Agent 用 files.register/open/import 的显式资源，不依赖原生选择器。
当前静态版不可用的 IGES 入口；不能宣称直接导入成功。
当前静态版不可用的旧服务端矢量入口；应查当前 readVector/Services 实际能力。

selectionGuide.policy: Discovery guidance only; compare input geometry, section/path, parameter meaning, result and side effects. Read the chosen full contract. These distinctions do not add execution blockers.
